verdict.rationale: Plaid documents an official MCP server at plaid.com/docs/resources/mcp/, indicating agents can connect via Plaid's own MCP integration. However, the evidence pack gives no detail on what IDV-specific functionality the MCP server exposes, no independent/hands-on corroboration, and no specifics on setup or scope. missing for 10: details on IDV-specific MCP tool coverage, independent verification/hands-on testing of the MCP server.
